verdict.rationale: Cactus ships an official CLI installable via Homebrew (`brew install cactus-compute/cactus/cactus`, then `cactus run`). It has subcommands such as `cactus convert` and `cactus benchmark`, the Needle package exposes `needle whistle compare`, and the llms.txt lists the CLI alongside coding agents as a way to drive the platform with an API key. Missing for 10: a full CLI command reference, agent-oriented CLI features such as machine-readable output, and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
